history.summary: Mathlib v4.24 lacks the edge-path or realized simplicial-cover theorem; the Builder found no sound short substitute within the fixed dependency boundary.

Nerve realization atlas, contraction, and unique simplex-lifting foundations compile, but no realized-covering or edge-path theorem was added: TopologicalComparisonStatement and Full/Faithful remain conditional, and the public equivalence is still absent.
Degeneracy-aware open core-face stars compile, but star saturation/trivialization, IsCoveringMap, Full/Faithful, the public equivalence, and the unconditional comparison remain absent.
Core-face lifts and simplex-coordinate sheet identities compile, but global quotient saturation, IsCoveringMap, Full/Faithful, the public equivalence, and the unconditional comparison remain absent.
